limitations: Local preload interval includes query, process startup, transport and completion polling; not isolated NIC bandwidth.
Provider elapsed*rate recovers bytes from rounded log fields; allocation supplies exact payload bound.
Native create/coldstart prints rounded tenths of seconds; do not use for submillisecond timing.
Sequential startup-line intervals describe actual event ordering; not a counterfactual latency result.
Successful Rnets records do not expose every failed or skipped scheduling attempt.
Two logical-node pipeline/consolidation and independent numerical correctness remain unqualified.
